claims.statement: The Theatre Comique advertised Tom Allen and Jem Mace in a grand boxing match on Tuesday and Wednesday, October 24 and 25, 1876.
claims.excerpt: Tuesday and Wednesday—Tom Allen and Jem Mace in a grand Doxing match.

claims.statement: The Theatre Comique advertised Tom Allen and Jem Mace as 'the Two Champions of the World' (printed as 'Twv').
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN and JEM MACE, the Twv Champions of the World

notes: Advertisement, not Allen's own words. Title wording is an advertising claim, not a recognised title.
